title: fix(runtime,service-print,console): the print door answers on a hosted kernel, and an absent service reads as a localized line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8B8aRQ1k4vfnyJv7jPNpww7)_

Fixes #36840

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 托管云端点「打印报价」不再报英文路由原文：平台现在能把打印请求送到环境自己的打印服务；环境没有启用打印服务时，用户看到的是本地化提示「此操作所需的服务在当前环境未启用，请联系管理员。」（11 种语言）。
- 属于 cloud 专题的 p1 缺陷，来自产品负责人在托管 HotCRM 上点「打印报价」报 404。托管环境真正出 PDF 还需要 cloud 给租户内核挂上打印服务并提供浏览器引擎；这一半怎么做（镜像内装浏览器、接外部浏览器，还是单独立项）在决策卡上等你定，本 PR 不依赖它。
- 出错的话只影响打印这一个入口和 api 类动作失败时的提示文字，不碰数据，可直接撤回。
- 本 PR 无需你做决定；托管打印的取舍在单独的决策卡上。

## What changes

Root cause, measured on `main`: `POST /api/v1/print/records` is mounted by `PrintServicePlugin` on the kernel's `http.server` only. A hosted tenant kernel owns no socket and registers no `http.server`, so the host's `createHonoApp` catch-all, and the `/actions` door's in-process forward of a `type: 'api'` action, hand the request to the runtime dispatcher, which had no domain for it: `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, shown to the user as `Route Not Found: /print/records`. This is the class #36506 bridged for the personal-view and attachment doors (ruling A on #22438); print is one more member of it.

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/print-door-service.ts`: `IPrintDoorService`, one optional transport-neutral member `handlePrintDoor(request: Request): Promise<Response>`, the shape of `IAttachmentDoorsService.handleAttachmentDoor`. Barrel export, type pins, `api-surface` and `export-origins` regenerated.
- `packages/services/service-print`: the `print` service gains `handlePrintDoor`, built in `init()` by `createPrintDoorMember` over `createDoorTableMember` and the very `registerPrintRoutes` the `http.server` mount runs (one shared `printRoutesDeps`), on a private table that never listens. The `http.server` mount is unchanged; no path is mounted twice. New runtime dependency on `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` (as service-storage has). The no-`http.server` warning now says the door is reached through the dispatcher.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/print.ts`: a `/print` own-door bridge claiming exactly `POST /print/records`, forwarded body-unread to the REQUEST kernel's `print` slot. No slot or no member answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming `@objectstack/service-print`; every other shape under `/print` keeps the ordinary `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`. Registered beside `/attachments`; row added to `route-ledger.ts`. No preamble-gate exemption.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`: `apiActionFailureMessage` reads a `type: 'api'` refusal whose code says the target's service is absent (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`) as the new `actions.serviceUnavailable` line in the host's language, read from the resident built-in catalogue the way the permission line is. A producer-marked `userMessage` still wins. The key is added to all 11 locale packs (zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`); the dead-key script's flowResponse bullet now names the second key.
- Changeset `36840-print-door-hosted.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-print`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console` patch.

Chosen reading of the card's expectation 2: show a readable localized message rather than hide the button. Hiding would need the console to learn which services each environment runs; the message covers every api action and every host shape now.

## Why

Every hosted HotCRM user who presses 「打印报价」 or Print Contract hits a raw route string today. The platform half makes the door reachable on the hosted shape and makes absence speak the user's language; the cloud half (mounting the service per environment and providing an engine) is a separate decision and is not in this PR.

## Verification

- `packages/services/service-print/src/print-door-member.test.ts` (new): the member is registered with and without an `http.server`; it answers byte-for-byte what the mount answers (anonymous 401); a non-door method or path answers `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` without reaching the door. With the existing plugin and ledger suites: 3 files, 14 tests pass.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts`: a `print` family joins the parametrised suite (forwarding with body unread, exact claim with 8 misses, environment-scoped spelling, 501 for empty slot / thrown lookup / missing member, per-request slot read, request-kernel isolation, sanitised 500s, both preamble gates). With `route-ledger.conformance`, `http-dispatcher` and `discovery-schema-conformance`: 4 files, 331 tests pass.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-print-door.conformance.test.ts` (new, real plugins, real better-auth sessions, `createHonoApp` over a kernel with no `http.server`): anonymous 401, a signed-in member on a deployment with no engine gets the door's own `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, both byte-identical to the self-hosted mount; without `PrintServicePlugin` the door answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the package. 4 tests pass. Before this PR each of these was the dispatcher's 404.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/flowResponse.test.ts`: the card's exact `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` body, a 501, a 503 and an `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` each read the zh-Hans and en line and never `/print/records`; an unknown locale falls back to English; a `userMessage` wins; a `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` control keeps its sentence. 73 tests pass. i18n package: 108 files pass after `gen:zh-hant`; `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys` and `check-i18n-dead-keys` (report, exit 0) run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: two artifacts reported stale and regenerated (`api-surface`, `export-origins`).
- Derived gate families (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, 117 commands, run locally on the tree before the CI fixes below): 114 exit 0; `check:test-source-alias` exit 1 (fixed in c6a48bff, re-run OK); `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (shallow clone, unbuilt dist), both covered by CI.
- Round-1 CI fixes: the `/print` domain declared in `check-route-envelope.mjs`; the route-ledger census sentence moved to 157 rows; an unused parameter in the new conformance test; source aliases for `@objectstack/service-print` / `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` where the print tests import them (service-print 135 tests, the conformance file 4, dogfood's five print and ledger files 25 pass / 8 skipped).
- `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx`: one paragraph on the route behind a kernel with no HTTP server, the 501, and the console line.
- CI at c6a48bff: 71 check-runs, 62 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed.

Read first:
1. `packages/runtime/src/domains/print.ts`: the bridge row.
2. `packages/services/service-print/src/print-service-plugin.ts`: the member built over the mount's own registration.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`: the localized line.

## Acceptance notes

- Hosted printing that produces a PDF still needs the cloud half (service mount per environment plus a browser engine), which awaits a maintainer decision; until then hosted users get the localized line. Nothing is deployed.
- `PrintServicePlugin.start()` probes the engine (one browser launch) on every kernel build. On a multi-tenant host that is one Chromium start per environment boot. Not changed here; noted for whoever builds the cloud half.
- The ActionRunner's script-action toast path is unchanged: only `type: 'api'` refusals read the new line, which is where this failure appears.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
